project.name: Watch Club - Head Office Admin Portal & Omnichannel Loyalty System
project.description: Enterprise Omnichannel Loyalty & POS System for Watch Club Indonesia (42+ Retail Boutiques)

stack.frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS v4
stack.relationalDatabase: PostgreSQL via Drizzle ORM (schema in src/db/schema.ts)

criticalInvariants: INV-001: Ledger and Audit entries must be append-only and immutable.
INV-002: Point calculations must follow strict tier multipliers (Platinum 1.75x, Gold 1.25x).
INV-003: Store receipt numbers must be unique and rejected if claimed twice.
INV-004: Dual-sync resilience must preserve local disk data if Firestore disconnects.
INV-005: Tombstone preservation must permanently prevent deleted members from ghost logging in.
